name: dragon-explainer
description: Write an explainer as one HTML file with a figure in every section drawn in the dragon notation, built from JSON, embedded as SVG, and checked before you share it

interface.longDescription: Writes an explainer of a system, a piece of research, or a setup as one HTML file you can hand to anyone. You agree on the outline first. Every section has a figure: a diagram written in the dragon notation, checked for errors and layout breaks with dragon, and embedded in the page as SVG, or a chart for times, amounts, numbers, and periods. The document shows one section at a time from a contents list, splits several topics into pages with header tabs, has a slide-in contents list on phones, and prints to PDF. The content is kept as JSON and the figures as .dragon files, so it can be rebuilt after any change. Before you see it, the document is checked for network use, structure, captions, and its text, with full wording rules for Japanese. The finished file opens offline. Building it runs dragon through npx, which needs Node.js.
defaultPrompt: Write an explainer with dragon figures on how OAuth sign-in works
